caption: Very affordable Fashion clip on braces 🛍️ Delivery not included #bracesinkigali #onlinebusiness #rwandatiktok🇷🇼 #rwandatrends #fashionbraces
hook_text: New stock in Kigali, Rwanda - Fashion clip on braces at 20k
first_3s: Black-gloved hands hold a teeth model wearing a clip-on brace; a small inset shows a mouth putting the same brace on; title text with the price (20k) sits at the top from the first frame

structure.what: title card 'New stock in Kigali, Rwanda, fashion clip on braces at 20k', first colour (Black) shown on model with inset try-on
one colour per cut (Light Blue, Pink, Dark blue) swapped on the same teeth model; colour name and phone number under each
WhatsApp number stays on screen the whole clip; last colour shown

camera: static locked-off, product centred on plain grey background
visual_style: clean product table, gloved hands, inset mouth try-on picture-in-picture
on_screen_text: Black / Light Blue / Pink / Dark blue
text_style: white bold sans, top of frame; small colour label and phone number bottom left
why_viral: A curiosity product (fashion braces) with the price in the title answers the first comment before it is asked, and the colour-by-colour loop keeps people watching; comments are all price, delivery and where-to-buy questions.
lesson_for_engine: Put price and place in the title card from frame 1 and show one variant per cut, with the phone number fixed on screen for the whole clip.

caption: Why spend more when you can look fresh for less?  ✅ Premium thrift brands ✅ Clean & high-quality ✅ Affordable prices ✅ Limited pieces – once it’s gone, it’s gone. Whether you’re hitting the gym, the streets, or just want that sporty vibe, we’ve got you covered. #thrift #enterpreneur #smallbusiness #kigalitiktok🇷🇼🇷🇼 #sportswear
first_3s: A hand holds up a Reebok top on a hanger in front of a clothes rail, a big white '6k' price over it and the title 'Affordable Thrift sportswear in Kigali' at the top

structure.what: title plus first item with its price (6k)
one garment per cut (Champion, Under Armour, Adidas shorts, Ethiopia jacket, zip tops), each held to camera with its own price (6k, 7.5k, 8k)
last items; call to order in the caption and bio (+250 792 949 999)

camera: static, one hand-held hanger at a time, same wall background
visual_style: home rail of clothes, warm room light, garment fills the frame
text_style: white bold, thin dark shadow; title top centre, price large near the bottom centre
cta: Order via the number in the bio
why_viral: Every item carries its own big price, so it works as a visual catalogue; shoppers watch to the end to see all prices and the brand logos are recognised instantly. 15x followers shows non-followers pushed it.
lesson_for_engine: For multi-item catalogues give each item its own large price tag and one cut, and keep the title (what plus city) fixed on top.

first_3s: A hand presses a black self-inking stamp onto a white paper bag; yellow box with the WhatsApp number top left and a white label 'ENVELOPE BRANDING TOOL' at the left edge; the first spoken-caption word GUYS in blue

structure.what: phone number box + product label + first caption words, stamp already in hand
stamp pressed on bags and envelopes, close hand shots, one caption word per beat (Mukunda, Cyangwa, Guhakwifashisha, Ama, Amafaranga)
number box returns with the label; last caption word

camera: handheld top-down close-up on a grey table
visual_style: cluttered desk, paper cups, branded bag as the sample, hands only
text_style: word-by-word captions in bold blue with white outline, centre bottom; contact in a yellow rounded box top-left, product name in white bar
voice: Kinyarwanda voice-over (inferred from word captions), muted watch
why_viral: A simple satisfying stamp-on-bag demo with the phone number on screen twice, plus Kinyarwanda word-by-word captions that hold attention; 24x followers means shares (189) carried it beyond the account.
lesson_for_engine: Burn the spoken Kinyarwanda in one word at a time and show the contact box at the start and the end around a close-up product demonstration.
notes: word-by-word Kinyarwanda captions over a stamp demo
